<thought>To propose a one‑step retrosynthesis, I will look for a retrosynthetic template that, in the forward direction, forms a cycloaddition product while losing a carbonyl (ketone/ester) and an alkyne. In the retrosynthetic direction this corresponds to breaking a C–C bond and a C–O carbonyl bond, and generating a ketone (or ester) and an alkyne as the two precursors. I will search the template catalog for such criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkyne"],
  "functional_groups_formed": null,
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C-O", "C#C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
